request.description:
**Valid Job ID**

GET [http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/1](http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/1)

**Headers:** Authorization: Bearer job owner token

**Expected**: 200 OK with full job details

---

**Non-existent Job ID**

GET [http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/99999](http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/99999)

**Headers:** Authorization: Bearer job owner token

**Expected**: 404 Not Found with "Job not found" message

---

**No Authentication**

GET [http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/1](http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/1)

(No Authorization header)

**Expected**: 401 Unauthorized

---

**Invalid Job ID**

GET [http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/-1](http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/-1)

**Headers:** Authorization: Bearer job owner token

**Expected**: 400 Bad Request (due to @Positive validation)
